parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that marks the position from which to start reading.

parameters.name: ScriptId
parameters.description: The ID of the cluster script. This parameter is valid only for NORMAL scripts.

parameters.name: ScriptName
parameters.description: The name of the cluster script. This parameter is valid only for NORMAL scripts and supports fuzzy search.

parameters.name: ScriptType
parameters.description:
The type of the cluster script. Valid values:

- BOOTSTRAP: a bootstrap script.

- NORMAL: a normal cluster script.
